title: deputyOS release manifest
description: Single-source-of-truth schema for the signed manifest.json that lives at the channel root of the deputyOS CDN (or, in dev, under dist/). Generated by scripts/manifest.sh and consumed by deputyctl::release. Schema version 1; bump on breaking changes.

release_version.description: CalVer Y.M.D, optionally with a pre-release suffix (e.g. 2026.4.27, 2026.4.27-rc1).

released_at.description: RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 timestamp of when this manifest was generated.

tracker.description: Upstream agent versions baked into this release (profile id -> upstream tag). Free-form; consumers may ignore unknown keys.

artefacts.description: Every signed image, OCI ref, or cloud snapshot in this release.

target.description: Hardware target id matching the TARGET= matrix (e.g. qemu-aarch64, rpi5, digitalocean).

profile.description: Profile id matching profiles/<id>.toml (e.g. openclaw, hermes).

filename.description: Basename of the artefact, per docs/03-image-builds.md naming: deputyos-<profile>-<target>-<version>-<channel>.<ext>

minisig_url.description: URL (https:// or relative or file://) of the detached minisign signature for this artefact.

url.description: Absolute or relative URL of the artefact. Relative URLs resolve against the manifest's own URL.

desktop_launchers.description: Desktop launcher binaries per Rust target triple (M2.5). Keyed by triple; deputyos-desktop self-update looks up its own host triple here, sha256 + minisign verifies the blob, and atomically replaces the running launcher. Optional; older manifests omit it and self-update reports 'no entry'.

triple.description: Rust target triple the launcher binary was built for (e.g. x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, aarch64-apple-darwin, x86_64-pc-windows-msvc). Must match the map key.

filename.description: Basename of the launcher binary, e.g. deputyos-desktop-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.

url.description: Absolute or relative URL of the launcher binary. Relative URLs resolve against the manifest's own URL.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex sha256 of the launcher binary bytes. deputyos-desktop compares this to the running binary's sha to decide 'up to date'.

minisig_url.description: URL (https:// or relative or file://) of the detached minisign signature for the launcher binary.

mounts_policy_schema_version.description: Schema version of /etc/deputyos/mounts-policy.json this release ships (M3.5). Bumped when the on-disk policy schema changes; consumers detect mismatches and migrate. Optional; defaults to 1 for older manifests.
